verification.ssoCheck: Unauthenticated GET on both the raw deployment URL and the production alias returns HTTP 200 with the full page (no Vercel Authentication challenge).

notes: proklinator.vercel.app is owned by an unrelated account, so Vercel assigned proklinator-singularity16.vercel.app as this project's production alias.

deploy_to_vercel with an explicit teamId returned 403 (no permission to create Preview/Production Deployment) for every name tried (proklinator, proklinator-static, proklinator-live); deploying to the token's default scope (same slug, singularity16) succeeded under the preferred name.

Team-scoped MCP tools (get_project, list_projects, get_deployment, update_project_deployment_protection) return 404 for this project, so Vercel Authentication was verified off by direct unauthenticated requests rather than toggled through the API.

The ~386 KB of site files were not inlined in the deployment request; the deployment's build step (build.mjs) fetches index.html and hero-altar.jpg and fails unless their SHA-256 digests match the pinned values above. The final deployment sources them from the immutable first deployment URL; temporary mirrors (litterbox.catbox.moe, temp.sh, expiring within 72h) were used only for the first build.

create_git_project failed because the Vercel account has no GitHub Login Connection; adding one (vercel.com/account/login-connections) would allow linking this private repo for automatic deploys from main.
